visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and a white puff-sleeved blouse stands before a neutral gray curtain. She holds a black smartphone and looks directly at the camera while speaking. (2) A second woman wearing a blue sweater abruptly leans into the frame from the side with an exaggerated wide-eyed expression of shock, looking towards the first woman. (3) The main character is now seated on a light beige sofa in a brightly lit indoor living room. She touches her cheek with her right hand, wearing a contemplative and slightly concerned facial expression while looking upwards. (4) The screen transitions to a macro close-up of a female face under a dark, greenish-blue ultraviolet diagnostic light, which highlights various dark pigmented spots on the cheek and chin area. Red circles are drawn on the screen as overlays to point out the imperfections. (5) Back in the bright indoor setting, the woman holds a small purple glass bottle with a white dropper cap close to the camera, showcasing the product packaging clearly while nodding. (6) A split-screen comparison appears with 'Before' and 'After' labels, showing side-by-side close-up images of skin texture improvement and fading of spots. Red circles highlight the specific areas of change. (7) The scene shifts to a professional event venue where a male doctor in a white lab coat is giving a presentation. He points to a projector screen displaying various skin types and anatomical charts of skin layers. (8) Close-up shots show the woman applying a pinkish serum from a dropper onto her palms and then gently massaging it into her face in a studio setting. (9) The woman smiles brightly at the camera, her skin appearing radiant and clear. Text overlays in colorful fonts appear around her face to emphasize the final results.
